typography.guidelines: Use Outfit for all Headings (H1-H6) with tight tracking (tracking-tight) and varied weights (e.g., font-light or font-black). Use Inter for body text with generous line-height (leading-relaxed). Introduce 'Magazine Style' typographical hierarchy: massive section numbers, delicate overlines (uppercase, wide tracking), and high-contrast font weights.

colors.guidelines: Maintain the CRM brand colors but apply them with an editorial sensibility. Use #0F172A for high-contrast primary text, #F8FAFC for the page background. Use Sky Blue (#0284C7) for primary CTAs and active states. Use Sunset Coral (#F97316) sparingly for alerts, badges, or special accents. Avoid generic SaaS styling; let the images provide the most color.

visual_enhancers.spacing: Adopt the Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use py-24 or py-32 between major sections. Within the timeline, space days by gap-16 or gap-20.
visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use crisp, solid surfaces with very subtle borders (border-slate-200) rather than heavy drop-shadows. This preserves the print-like, elegant feel of a brochure.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Apply high-end glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border-t border-slate-200) strictly to the mobile sticky action bar to keep it non-intrusive yet highly legible.

layouts.hero: A full-bleed min-h-[80vh] container. Top element: A simulated 'Header Banner' (e.g., a branded strip or mock image) dynamically injected per sector. The rest of the hero features the destination image with a subtle dark gradient overlay (bg-gradient-to-t from-black/70 via-black/20 to-transparent). Destination title positioned at the bottom-left, using text-5xl to text-7xl font-black text-white.
layouts.day_by_day_timeline: A vertical spine layout. Each 'Day' block features a prominent but stylized day indicator (e.g., a large muted number '01' behind the text, or a sleek vertical line with a primary-colored dot). Next to the route description (rich HTML style), place a 2-to-3 image Bento grid for destinations/hotels (use varying aspect ratios like square and tall).
layouts.costing_and_policies: Costing: A prominent, elegant 'Price Summary' card. Policies (Inclusions, Exclusions, Payment, Cancellation): Clean, minimalist Shadcn Accordions with border-b-only styling to mimic a sophisticated document.
layouts.sticky_action_bar: Fixed to bottom-0 w-full. Mobile-friendly flex container housing 3 buttons: 'Accept Quote' (Primary, full-width or dominant), 'Download PDF' (Secondary/Outline, icon-only on very small screens), 'Chat on WhatsApp' (Green or Accent outline, icon + text). Use z-50 to hover above all content.

components_to_use.Card: For price breakdown and sector branding blocks.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Do not make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons. Use lucide-react icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions. Exclude transforms from universal transitions.
Do NOT apply a universal 'transition: all' rule.
DO NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }). This disrupts the human natural reading flow.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing. Example: data-testid='accept-quote-btn'
CRITICAL: Do not use a completely transparent background on sticky/floating elements. The sticky action bar MUST have a solid or blurred background.
instructions_to_main_agent: Create a seamless, single-page scroll experience (magazine-style brochure) in App.js. Start with the sector Header Banner, then the Hero section. Use framer-motion to add subtle scroll fade-ins for the timeline days. Use lucide-react for all icons. The Sticky Action bar should be fixed at the bottom of the viewport. Ensure the typography adheres strictly to Outfit for headings and Inter for body text as configured in tailwind and CSS. Construct a 'mock' rich-text layout for the day descriptions alongside the bento-box image grids.
